findings.summary: A truncated response body counts as a whole answer: step 1 passes on it and steps 2 to 5 fail only because the JSON does not parse.
A URL with a non-ASCII character in its path exits 1 with no request sent, where every other refused URL exits 2.
A full run imports two length constants from the app, so it needs the app's packages installed; the module is not standard-library only for the full check.
IPv6 loopback could not be tested end to end because the sandbox cannot bind ::1.
The tests of the make target are in a file the issue's Constraints do not name.
A name that resolves to several unreachable addresses takes one connect timeout per address; excluded by the reworded time-limit criterion (the human's ruling).
